parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against the target CHEMBL5990. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id to CHEMBL5990 and assays.assay_organism to Homo sapiens. Require compound_structures joined as an INNER JOIN on molregno to ensure canonical SMILES are present. Sort results by compound ChEMBL identifier.
